meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 能将 Python 代码（Flask、Django、FastAPI 等）部署到 Azure App Service Linux。自动创建所需资源、检测框架、设置启动命令并部署，部署后不进行验证。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”或“FastAPI App Service”等关键词时触发。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can deploy Python code (Flask, Django, FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux. It automatically creates resource group, plan, detects framework, sets startup command, and deploys via azd or az. No post-deploy verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", or "FastAPI App Service".

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask code to Azure App Service
Deploy myapp.py to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Claude deploys the specified Python file
